description: This file defines the `HTMLPurifier_DoctypeRegistry` class, which manages a registry of document types (doctypes) for the HTML Purifier library. It includes methods for registering, retrieving, and creating doctypes based on configuration, as well as handling aliases.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_DoctypeRegistry
classes.description: A class for managing a registry of HTML document types, including registering new doctypes, retrieving and alias resolution, and creating doctypes based on configuration.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new doctype in the registry, accepting either a doctype object or parameters to construct one, and manages aliases.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a doctype from the registry by name, resolving aliases, and creating a default doctype if not found.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Creates a clone of a doctype based on configuration, used for initializing doctypes with specific settings.

methods.name: getDoctypeFromConfig
methods.description: Extracts the doctype name from a configuration object, considering various settings and backward compatibility.
